## Benchmark Cities

Benchmark cities are selected as cities in neighboring countries with a population of 50% to 150% of the focus city's population, plus any manually specified cities.

```{r}
#| label: setup-benchmark
#| include: false
if (file.exists("_quarto.yml")) here::i_am("tasks/benchmark/charts/index.qmd")
if (!exists("aoi")) source(here::here("core/R/setup.R"))

pop_longitude <- tryCatch(
  read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_pop_benchmark.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE),
  error = function(e) tibble(Year = integer(), Population = numeric(),
                             Location = character(), Country = character(),
                             Group = character(), Area_km = numeric(),
                             Source = character(), Method = character()))
```

```{r}
#| label: benchmark-cities-table
#| results: asis

if (nrow(pop_longitude) > 0 && "Group" %in% names(pop_longitude)) {
  print_text("Benchmark cities")

  pop_longitude %>%
      subset(Group != city) %>%
      group_by(Location) %>%
      slice_min(abs(Year - 2021), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      arrange(Location) %>%
      print_paged_df()

  # Footnote: which benchmark cities came from Oxford Economics
  oxford_bm <- pop_longitude %>% subset(Group == "Benchmark - Oxford")
  if (nrow(oxford_bm) > 0) {
    print_text(paste_bold("Benchmark footnote text:"))
    print_text("Following cities are included in Oxford Economics dataset:", 1)
    oxford_bm %>%
      select(Location, Country) %>% distinct() %>%
      arrange(Country) %>% group_by(Country) %>%
      summarize(text = paste_and(Location), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(text = paste0(text, " (", Country, ")")) %>%
      .$text %>% paste_and() %>%
      paste_bold() %>%
      print_text()
  }
}
```
